title: Austin Budget Woes, New Board Members, Land Talks
summary:
*   City officials reported a substantial $10.6 million budget shortfall.
*   New members were appointed to key civic groups, including the Cable Commission and the Child Care Commission.
*   An executive session was held to discuss land acquisition for municipal office consolidation, as well as ongoing litigation and personnel matters.

4TH FLOOR AUDITORIUM OF THE CENTRAL LIBRARY Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street,
Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of
the Council, noting the absence of Councilmembers Rose and Urdy.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
City Manager Carrasco discussed the $10.6 million shortfall in the City budget in his
Budget Update report.
Members of the hospital staff and members of the Hospital Board reported on Rehabilitation
Hospital at Brackenridge.
WORK SESSION RESCHEDULED
The work session as a joint meeting with the Electric Utility Commission was withdrawn and
will be rescheduled at a later date.
BUDGET AMENDMENT POSTPONED
Council considered amending the 1986-87 annual operating budget by appropriating an
additional $30,000 to the Parks and Recreation Department for the Zilker summer musical.
Staff did not have the information Council asked for so it will be discussed at a later
date.
BOARD & COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS
The Council, on Councilmember. Shipman's motion, Mayor Cooksey's second, appointed Beverly
Scarbrough as a member of the Cable Commission. (5-0 Vote, Councilmembers
Rose and Urdy absent)
